canon.name: Big Squeeze
canon.frame: a wide view of a kid's lemonade stand on a sunny suburban sidewalk, watched by a fixed camera across the street at child height, the whole stand framed in the middle with the sidewalk on both sides, a green lawn and white picket fence behind and a bright blue sky above
canon.still: The camera holds perfectly steady on the whole stand for the whole clip while the striped awning flaps gently in the breeze, puffy clouds drift and a little bird hops along the fence
canon.approach: In the first half second, {thing} wobbles and swells up with a big cartoon boing
canon.arrive: {thing} pops into view {place} with a bouncy cartoon boing
canon.leave: {thing} rolls away down the street and out of view
canon.settle: In the last second, everything bounces to a stop and the camera holds perfectly steady on the whole stand, every thing in its new place and pose while the awning flaps gently
canon.ambient: Birds chirp, ice cubes clink in a pitcher and a bouncy ukulele and kazoo tune plays somewhere down the street
canon.selectSound: A cheerful cartoon boing and a slide whistle
canon.lettering: a kid's neat hand painted brush lettering in navy blue, sentence case
canon.style: bright stop motion claymation, sunny saturated colors

ladder.mood: a sleepy little lemonade stand on a quiet sunny morning
the customers are getting very strange and business is booming
ladder.ambient: A short line of curious neighbors peeks over the picket fence holding paper cups
ladder.sound: A cash register dings again and again

ladder.mood: the lemon machinery is out of control and loving it
ladder.ambient: Small yellow lemons bounce and roll along the sidewalk
ladder.sound: Pipes gurgle and a steam whistle toots a happy tune

ladder.mood: the stand is a towering lemonade empire and the whole town wants in
ladder.ambient: A lemon shaped blimp drifts slowly across the sky trailing a yellow banner
ladder.sound: A crowd down the street chants and cheers

ladder.mood: the neighborhood is turning into a lemonade theme park
ladder.ambient: Yellow streamers and lemon balloons float up from every rooftop
ladder.sound: A brass band plays a bouncy march

ladder.mood: the whole street throws a giant lemonade parade in the kid's honor
ladder.ambient: Yellow confetti rains down over the whole street
ladder.sound: A marching band of kazoos plays and a huge crowd cheers

filler: The camera stays fixed across the street, framing the whole stand
Everything is soft modeling clay with visible thumbprints
Bright morning sunlight casts soft round shadows on the sidewalk
Puffy clay clouds drift slowly across the blue sky
The white picket fence runs straight across behind the stand
The lawn is bright green and neatly bumpy
Colors are bold and sunny, lemon yellow, sky blue, grass green and cherry red
Edges are crisp and the picture is sharp from edge to edge
The framing stays wide and level on the whole sidewalk
Shapes are chunky, round and slightly lumpy like handmade clay
Little clay flowers line the bottom of the fence
The striped awning is lemon yellow and white
Small houses with red roofs sit far behind the fence
Every big thing is easy to see from across the street
